descriptions.preferred: 由美国Green Mansion Nursery 的比利 · 施瓦兹育种 ， 并 以他的第三个孩子的名字 命名 ， 与 Acer Palmatum'Matthew's Broom' 属于异名同株，是一款目前市面上比较少见的矮生型 突变品种。 春天为黄绿色或者亮绿色，夏季转为青绿色，秋季为橙红或者橙黄色 。 叶型为5-7 叶裂，以 5 裂为主，叶裂非常深，小叶有锯齿 。 生长速度较慢，属于 矮生 品种，株形呈矮灌状，成年株可达1. 5 米左右高度 ，比较耐寒。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Matthew' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Originating as a witches broom, this little guy will add interesting color and texture to any garden. Deeply divided leaves emerge in spring decidedly yellow with red edges in more sun. Fall color is excellent and mostly orange with hints of yellow. Tolerates full sun in most climates but prefers at least a short break from the afternoon sun in hotter areas. Sometimes listed as 'Mathews Broom'. 10 year size: Height: 4-6 feet Width: 3-5 feet
